title: *The note an ambient AI scribe drafts follows the template it is given. This page links each approved scribe's guide to writing a template, provincial tips on speaking so the scribe hears what matters, and the research on where scribe notes go wrong, so the template and the review that follows it can target those errors.*

heading: Key Sources
title: Island Health - AI ToolKit: AI Scribe Limitations and Mitigations
note: the errors Island Health expects from AI scribes (fabricated content, missed context, accents, bias, noise) and how medical staff, including NPs, can mitigate each; notes that most scribes don't learn from your edits
keywords: ai scribe errors limitations mitigation template

heading: Key Sources
title: Health PEI - AI Scribe Tips and Tricks for Health Care Providers
note: Prince Edward Island: two-page tip sheet from a provincial AI scribe pilot (Tali) open to NPs: signposting the visit aloud, narrating exam findings and pertinent negatives, several patients in one visit, customizing SOAP templates and macros
keywords: verbalize narrate exam signpost pertinent negatives macro

heading: Key Sources
title: Asgari et al. - Clinical Safety and Hallucination Rates of LLMs for Medical Text Summarisation
note: International source: UK study (npj Digit Med 2025) of 18 prompt and workflow versions for AI-drafted notes, with the error rate of each change and the note sections where hallucinations clustered (the Plan)
keywords: prompt wording hallucination omission plan section
